blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for non-file traversal limits and unreadable paths
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage, so implementations can ignore several required indeterminate cases and still pass these tests.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires indeterminate results when either scan reaches maxDepth, maxDirectoryEntries, maxFiles, or an unreadable non-excluded path. The tests only exercise maxFiles limits for source and docs scans.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local tests for at least maxDepth, maxDirectoryEntries, and unreadable non-excluded path behavior, or otherwise cover each required limit/error condition explicitly.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage, so implementations can ignore several required indeterminate cases and still pass these tests.

blockingFindings.title: Policy name is not actually asserted
blockingFindings.rationale: A test could pass with an unnamed or wrong policy string, leaving the named-policy API requirement unverified.
blockingFindings.issue: R1/R3 require one named freshness source policy and JSON details containing the policy name, but assertScanDetail only checks that policy is some string.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the expected policy name value for sourceScan/docsScan, and ensure tests distinguish the source freshness policy from an arbitrary string.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A test could pass with an unnamed or wrong policy string, leaving the named-policy API requirement unverified.
